name: lol-companion-bridge
description: Node.js bridge between the Riot Live Client API and the Flutter coaching app

scripts.build:exe:windows: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/bridge.exe
scripts.build:exe:macos: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.js --targets node18-macos-x64 --output dist/bridge
scripts.build:exe:linux: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output dist/bridge
